raw_content: {"output_action": "PATCH", "skill_draft": null, "patch_target_id": "t000010", "patch_section": "Core Action", "patch_content": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns empty `strong_findings` or low confidence scores: (1) Do NOT proceed with diagnosis based solely on clinical text or assume normality; (2) Immediately call `chest_xray_report_generator` to obtain detailed descriptive morphological evidence (e.g., consolidations, infiltrates, opacities); (3) Integrate these descriptive findings with clinical history to support the differential diagnosis."}
